title: Q4 RingCentral innovation updates: One scorecard for AI and human calls, fewer ‘Spam Likely’ labels
summary: This quarter you can score AI and human calls on one scorecard, handle RingCX interactions inside Teams and the RingCentral mobile app and stop “Spam
body_markdown:
This quarter you can score AI and human calls on one scorecard, handle RingCX interactions inside Teams and the RingCentral mobile app and stop “Spam Likely” labels from costing you answered calls.


## Find out which calls AI should handle and which need a person


**AI Conversation Expert (ACE) scores AI and human calls on one scorecard.** An AI agent can finish a call and still handle it badly. Connect RingCentral AI agents to ACE, and its calls get the same scorecards, trackers, and sentiment analysis as your human team’s calls. AI CSAT adds a customer satisfaction (CSAT) score for AI-handled calls. Let AI handle high-volume, low-risk, repetitive calls and route the rest to a person. Browse ACE integrations in the[App Gallery](https://www.ringcentral.com/apps/p/ai-conversation-expert) , or[read the full ACE blog](https://www.ringcentral.com/us/en/blog/build-memory-every-call/) for more details.


**Manage AI agents and human agents as one workforce.** RingCX supervisors can surface AI agent interactions in the Supervisor Dashboard alongside human agents. They can identify issues in real time, coach the agent, or take over the call, regardless of whether the interaction is handled by AI or a human agent. Learn more about the[Supervisor Dashboard here](https://support.ringcentral.com/article-v2/Understanding-the-supervisor-dashboard.html?brand=RingCentral&product=RingCX&language=en_US) .


**Handle RingCX interactions in Teams or the RingCentral mobile app.** RingEX and RingCX run together inside the RingCentral mobile app and Microsoft Teams. Agents stay in the app they already have open instead of switching tools. RingCX for Mobile and Microsoft Teams requires a RingCX license. Find the[Teams app integration](https://www.ringcentral.com/apps/microsoft-teams-dialer?utm_source=app-gallery&utm_campaign=featured) and other[RingCX integrations](https://www.ringcentral.com/apps/p/ringcx) in the App Gallery.


## Stop “Spam Likely” labels from costing you answered calls


Customers who see “Spam Likely” often skip the call, even for appointment reminders and fraud alerts.


**Number Reputation Service** is a managed service: RingCentral verifies your business, registers your numbers, watches for spam labels, and submits corrections for wrong ones. Numeracle works with the carrier analytics providers, so your team doesn’t deal with each one. It’s available today for RingEX customers with eligible numbers.[Learn how Number Reputation Service works](https://www.ringcentral.com/us/en/blog/introducing-number-reputation-service/) .


## Where to start


- Contact center leads: connect RingCentral AI agents to AI Interaction Analytics and review AI CSAT by call type.
- RingCX admins: give your agents RingCX in Teams or the RingCentral mobile app, and find the Teams app in the[App Gallery](https://www.ringcentral.com/apps/p/index) .
- Anyone placing outbound calls: register your eligible RingEX numbers with Number Reputation Service.


To see these in action and find out what else is new, register for our[What’s New webinars](https://go.ringcentral.com/community-webinar-registrations.html) or visit[What’s new at RingCentral.](https://www.ringcentral.com/whats-new.html)
